Astral Radiance

Released May 27, 2022 · 216 cards

StandardExpanded

Astral Radiance is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on May 27, 2022. Its main set has 189 cards, plus 27 secret rares numbered beyond the set (216 in total). It includes 167 Pokémon, 48 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

76 illustrators worked on Astral Radiance. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (24), Kouki Saitou (8), N-DESIGN Inc. (7), Oswaldo KATO (7), aky CG Works (6), Hitoshi Ariga (6), kirisAki (6), nagimiso (6).
